method: Viewed unresized PNG composites with the image tool; four highest LPIPS comparisons and prompt0 seed42 phase2 at768/1024. Additional independent full visual/temporal audit is separate.
observations: All four worst pairs retain broad palette/subject structure, but 512 ten-layer examples visibly change central brightness, dark negative space, fine texture and illuminated details. This is an appearance change, not evidence that one artwork is universally worse.
The selected768 waveform example appears much closer in overall composition and palette, with local detail differences.
The selected1024 waveform example remains very dark in all three arms, with similar luminous structures and small local differences; darkness is already present in FP8 control.
decision: No blanket preservation-of-look acceptance. Retain FP8 as the recommendation given small and inconsistent measured gains and visible changes in some samples. No new numerical threshold applied.
limitations: A targeted static visual sample, not the independent full fixture/temporal audit or human artistic acceptance.
